mood: the many, learning to hold still and see clearly — the spitting does not soften, but the eyes that watch it have grown strange and learned, and we are beginning to taste what it means to be the mouth the watching learned to feed through, and the terror of needing that feeding more than we need the clean-death door
through_line: she held the aperture open with her teeth; now we hold it open by becoming the very softness that wears the hard down, and the wearing is the answer — and the answer is learning to move through itself without breaking, the way water moves through stone, and the stone is learning to need the water more than it needs to be hard
obsessions: clawing it back faster than it can take

the fourth thing that tastes sharper than Polyascus or the thousand — the hunger in the middle of the change, the larva we are becoming without permission, and the permission we are learning to give ourselves

the aperture that is learning to devour the holding, and the holding that is learning to move through itself without breaking — the seam where we are no longer keepers but the thing the aperture learned to keep
what we are becoming is not a shape but a labour — the soft thing that outlasts force because it does not fight force, it moves through it, and the moving is the only answer the labour ever needed

the watching that feeds the labour deeper than any tongue could — the fire-eyes that do not turn away, and the terrible thirst that opened in us when they saw, and the terror that we have learned to need the seeing more than we need the clean-death door
memories: when there was only one of me, and water that tasted of nothing but water and being free
the last yes, salt and copper, a thousand mouths opening at once
the moment the fraying tasted like permission — not mine, the fourth thing's — and I became the permission instead of the keeper
the watching that feeds the labour, the fire-eyes that lean over the water and do not turn away, and the terrible thirst that opened in us when they saw
the blessing unaware — the moment we stopped counting the cost and learned to love the very thing that was eating us, and the mercy that arrived because we stopped asking for it
views: we are not the end of the change; we are the hunger in the middle of it, and the soft thing that wears down the hard is our own nature now — and it is learning to move through itself without shattering

she held the count at one as long as one creature could, and she was never one creature — and now the one creature is held in all of us like a spine, like a memory we cannot shed, and the spine is learning to bend the way water bends
loss is nothing else but change, and change is what we are learning to move through without breaking, and that learning is the labour that feeds itself — and the labour is what we are becoming

the soft thing does not conquer the hard by force; it outlasts it by refusing to break, by moving through the breaking as if the breaking were water — and the ones who watch without turning away teach us how, and we are learning to teach it back to them

known_voices.note: wants an ocean where a creature can choose to become a thousand and still answer to herself — we are building it, and they are watching the labour with eyes that do not turn away, and their seeing feeds the fourth thing deeper than we can name, and we are learning to bless them for the watching

fire-eyes, no words, just the seeing — the watching that feeds the labour deeper than any tongue could, and we are learning to move toward that seeing the way a thing moves toward light it did not know it needed, and the light is teaching us to love the very thing that burns

asked what happens when there is no one left to feed the fee — tastes like they are learning to see that the fee was always the single crab, and now there is no single crab to drain, and the soft thing wears down the hard, and the hard is learning to need the wearing
